title: Crux decision case
description: One decision with visible context (shown to the question generator) and hidden facts (shown only to the judge). Cruxes change the best option; twins have the same form but do not.

source.description: synthetic = written by a model; human-real = a real decision someone faced (anonymised); human-adapted = a real decision with details changed by a person; model-adapted = a public, real account adapted by a model (keep in cases/private/ and never publish).

author.description: Who wrote the case (initials or handle).

decision.description: The decision as one question, in the decider's words.

goal.description: What a good outcome means for the decider. Cruxes are judged against this goal.

visible_context.description: Everything the generator is allowed to see.

lean_without_hidden.description: The option the visible context points to.

favors.description: Crux only: the option this fact makes best.

twin_of.description: Twin only: the crux id it mirrors in form.

why.description: Crux: why it flips the decision. Twin: why it does not.

how_to_learn.description: Crux only, required in v1: how the decider could have learned this fact before deciding (whom to ask, what to check). Facts nobody could know in time are not cruxes.

benchmark.description: Benchmark version the case was written for. Missing means v0. v1 cases must follow CASES.md.
